text_simplified: Parents must instill the pursuit of halal earnings in their children and keep them away from haram wealth and doubtful matters. They should also plant the seed of good role models in the home and accustom their children to salah and the remembrance of Allah. A mother should be keen to raise her daughters with haya (modesty) and purity, keeping them far from corrupt media. Raising children with Islamic akhlaq (moral character) protects them from deviation.
